बॉक्स ऑफिस पर आया Ranbir Kapoor और Yash का धमाकेदार तूफान! 💥

Nitesh Tiwari के निर्देशन में बनी फिल्म Ramayana ने सोमवार 9 November को BookMyShow पर अब तक का सबसे बड़ा रिकॉर्ड कायम कर दिया है। 🎬

Govardhan Puja के मौके पर इस फिल्म ने 1 घंटे में 132.5K टिकट्स बेचकर भारतीय सिनेमा का नया इतिहास रच दिया है। 🚀

Ramayana ने Ranveer Singh की Dhurandhar 2 के 109.17K और Allu Arjun की Pushpa 2: The Rule के 107.65K hourly ticket sales के रिकॉर्ड को पीछे छोड़ दिया है। 🔥

Day 5 advance booking में ही फिल्म ने 53 crore gross कलेक्शन हासिल किया और 14.28 lakh से ज्यादा टिकट्स पहले ही बिक चुके थे। 📊

North India में Ranbir Kapoor और South बेल्ट में Yash के जबरदस्त क्रेज की वजह से BookMyShow पर एडवांस बुकिंग की सुनामी आ गई। ✨

क्या आपने भी Ramayana की टिकट बुक करवा ली है? कमेंट्स में जरूर बताइए! 👇

ctx.title: Ramayana Box Office Record: Creates History With Biggest Hourly BMS Sales: Beats Dhurandhar 2 & Pushpa 2 To Hit The Biggest Milestone!
ctx.summary:
Ramayana has created a historic record with the biggest hourly ticket sales on BMS with its Monday sales - BMS trend report. 
 The post  Ramayana Box Office Record: Creates History With Biggest Hourly BMS Sales: Beats Dhurandhar 2 & Pushpa 2 To Hit The Biggest Milestone!  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
The online ticketing universe has exploded into complete madness for director Nitesh Tiwari’s monumental mythological spectacle Ramayana featuring Ranbir Kapoor, Yash, and Sai Pallavi. On Monday, day 5, November 9, Govardhan Puja, the film is shattering every single digital benchmark in existence on BookMyShow.
Riding on extraordinary post-Diwali word-of-mouth and nationwide festive momentum, the mythological epic has officially created history by becoming the first Indian film in history to breach 130K+ ticket sales in a single hour on BookMyShow!
Peaking at a staggering 132.5K tickets per hour, Ramayana has smashed the previous all-time peak hourly records held by Ranveer Singh’s Dhurandhar 2 ( 109.17K ) and Allu Arjun’s Pushpa 2: The Rule ( 107.65K ) to claim the undisputed #1 spot in Indian ticketing history!
Yash and Ranbir Kapoor’s film registered 21.3% higher hourly sales than the biggest peak hour of Indian Cinema, registered by Dhurandhar 2. Ranveer Singh’s biggie registered a ticket sale of 109.17K on BMS.
With its 132.5K peak hourly acceleration, Ramayana now leads the top tier of Bollywood’s most explosive online ticketing streak!
Check out the top 10 hourly ticket sales of Bollywood films on BMS.
With 53 crore gross locked in pure Day 5 advance bookings, over 14.28 lakh tickets were pre-booked prior to Monday morning. As work hours resumed, nationwide family groups flooded BMS to lock in evening and night shows, causing a massive surge in hourly sales. The duo pull of Ranbir Kapoor across Hindi mass-multiplex belts and Yash across South dubbing circuits generated heavy simultaneous booking traffic across North India, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, and Telangana.
Monday numbers are all set for a roaring surprise already! Figures yet to be awaited!
